title: From High-Speed Idiot to High-Speed Yes-Man
blurb: AI speeds up output while organizations may be weakening the people, incentives and conditions needed to validate it. The paper names the pattern and proposes a position for the human: above the loop.

title: The Great UI Convergence: What a Five-Minute Test Demo Can Prove
blurb: That convergence is useful, and it creates a blind spot for buyers. Time to first green tells you how quickly you got a check running.

title: Confirming What You Meant, and What You Never Meant: The Oracle Problem in Agentic Testing
blurb: Presented to the Software Quality Group of New England, with the Oracle Readiness Screen handout: eight questions to ask before you trust a result from an automated or agentic test.
